scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @gksk/server" "npm run dev -w @gksk/client"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n mock,server,client -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @gksk/mock-gksk-api" "npm run dev -w @gksk/server" "npm run dev -w @gksk/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @gksk/shared && npm run build -w @gksk/mock-gksk-api && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @gksk/shared && npm run build -w @gksk/mock-gksk-api && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gksk/shared && npm run build -w @gksk/server && npm run build -w @gksk/client
